meta.note: Lowest Defence level a monster can be drained to, by Wiki monster name (any version). "base" = can't be drained. Others can be drained to 0. Checked on the Wiki (25 Nov): Verzik 'Her defence cannot be lowered'; Sotetseg min 100; the Nightmare min 120; Ba-Ba min 60; Kephri min 60; Zebak min 50; Wardens P3 min 120 (also after enraging); Nex 'reduced a maximum of 10 levels' (260 -> 250); Araxxor drained by up to 45 (135 -> 90); Hueycoatl 'only drain up to 5 levels' (125 -> 120); Yama 'only be reduced by 80 (from 225 down to 145)'; The Fractured Archive bosses from its strategy page. Vardorvis: his Defence falls with his health instead (see dps-monster-overrides.json). Not stated on the Wiki pages read, kept from other sources: Akkha 70, Phosani's Nightmare 120.
